name: Chilli Garlic Tofu
steps: Toss the tofu in cornflour and a pinch of salt. Pan-sear in a non-stick pan with half the oil for 8 minutes until crisp on all sides. Set aside.
Heat the remaining oil and fry the garlic and chillies for 30 seconds.
Add the capsicum and stir-fry for 2 minutes on high heat.
Add the soy sauce, chilli sauce, vinegar and 2 tbsp water, then return the tofu.
Toss until glazed, about 2 minutes. Finish with spring onions and pepper.
note: An Indo-Chinese dish made with a fraction of the usual oil by searing rather than deep-frying.
